historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly requires a peer but its command can run the local server on the client host while connecting elsewhere and silently invents profile parameters.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves generic source parameters pending approval and requires exact topology, counters and comparable NIC baseline.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Do not inherit ConnectX row14's iperf-v2-like60/300 profile or InfiniBand perftest semantics.

original_test_intent: Measure iperf3 Ethernet throughput between a designated SUT and peer under an approved connection/time/interval profile and compare it to the applicable NIC specification.
original_method: Record both endpoint and NIC/BDF/interface/IP/VLAN/MTU/route/link/driver/firmware identities and baseline counters/logs; verify compatible iperf3 and isolated path; approve server/client roles, direction, streams, duration, interval, port and thresholds; start the server with recorded PID; run the client to the explicit server address; capture complete interval/final/retransmit/CPU/counter evidence; stop only the test process, restore settings and assess against the versioned NIC profile.
manual_activity: Network owners provide endpoints, roles, isolated path, profile and NIC-specific acceptance; agent may install/validate iperf3 and execute the approved paired run.
required_inputs: SUT/peer host and NIC BDF/interface/IP/VLAN/MTU/route/port mapping and endpoint roles
NIC model/driver/firmware/negotiated speed/FEC/autoneg plus production-safe isolation
Approved iperf3 package/version/hash, direction, parallel connections, duration, interval and optional window
Abort, firewall/process cleanup and restoration policy
safety_requirements: Dedicated or approved network path and peer-owner approval
Verify server readiness, client route and exact test interface before traffic
Use authenticated access and record process IDs; never kill unrelated iperf processes
Stop on wrong path, production impact, error/loss storm, link flap or CPU/thermal instability
No automatic retry; restore temporary firewall/routing/affinity and verify connectivity
agent_execution_scope: Run approved server/client pair and collect complete evidence
Stop recorded processes and verify final health/restoration
Do not choose profile/spec, invent placeholders, change production networking independently, rerun or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve endpoint roles, NIC/path and isolation
Resolve connection count, duration, interval, direction and port
Provide NIC-specific thresholds and abort/cleanup policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unsafe and semantically ambiguous: it starts a local server then connects to SERVER_IP from the same SSH target, invents -P4/-t60/-i10, installs packages without a pinned source, uses insecure SSH and retains tail-only proof.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: On the approved server run the validated iperf3 server bound to the test IP/port and record PID/log; on the separate approved client run `iperf3 -c <SERVER_IP>` with explicitly approved `-P`, `-t`, `-i`, direction and output options; preserve complete logs from both endpoints.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source's server/client split, parameterized number_of_connection/TEST_TIME/interval_time and NIC-spec comparison are preserved without adopting DeepSeek's defaults.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run one topology-bound iperf3 server/client profile with complete endpoint, counter and health evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit identity, version, path, thresholds, telemetry and deterministic cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A tailed client file cannot establish server behavior, interval stability, retransmits or post-test system health.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Stream count, CPU/NUMA affinity, direction, MTU and negotiated link conditions can dominate throughput and must match the approved NIC baseline.

project_override_considerations: The source intentionally leaves connection count, time and interval as placeholders. DeepSeek's4/60/10 is a proposal, not source truth. Decide endpoint roles and whether NIC spec means line-rate utilization or an application-throughput floor.
expected_evidence: Exact server/client commands, approved streams/time/interval/direction and complete output
Per-interval/final throughput, retransmits/loss/errors and CPU/thermal telemetry
Before/after counters and system/BMC logs on both endpoints
Restoration proof, versioned threshold comparison and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently defines an iperf3 server/client workflow with parameter placeholders. DeepSeek's invented profile and same-shell orchestration are review defects, not contradictions in the primary source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The package, peer, role/profile, path and thresholds can be supplied; the static intent and criterion are identifiable.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Performance row19 Wistron-Performance Networking-00034-V006: approve SUT/peer server-client roles and exact NIC/BDF/interface/IP/VLAN/MTU/route/port/path, iperf3 package/version/hash, direction, number_of_connection, TEST_TIME, interval_time/window and production isolation; provide negotiated-link-specific throughput/utilization, retransmit/loss/error/CPU/system-health thresholds plus abort and cleanup policy.

review_improvement: Keeps the source parameterized instead of silently adopting arbitrary defaults, resolves endpoint-role ambiguity and requires complete attributable evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: iperf3 throughput is jointly determined by endpoint role, route, stream count, direction, CPU placement and link configuration. Starting a local server while connecting the client to another SERVER_IP does not prove which server is measured. A NIC-spec comparison is valid only when the tested path and profile match the baseline and both endpoint outputs and counters show a stable, error-free run.
